plain: Theft of public money by an official

webster.text: The act, practice or crime of defrauding the public by appropriating to one's own use the money or goods entrusted to one's care for management or disbursement; embezzlement of public money or goods.

example.quote: He might pervert his administration into a scheme of peculation or oppression.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, July 20, 1787
